title: Our own AI harness on OpenRouter: research

text: Taken: the research topic is open at /framework/research/harness/ with seven sub-areas. One Opus and one Sonnet scout are digging now; spend so far about $0.5 of $15.

The Opus scout landed 22 entries ($1.15). Its headline: we may not need a new harness first, since the Claude Agent SDK can already run other models through OpenRouter by changing one base URL, so step one is a small test run, not a build.

Round 1 is in: 50 entries for $2.79, and both scouts reached the same answer on their own: keep the Claude Agent SDK and add OpenRouter as a second backend, not a rewrite. A fresh Opus that has not seen their reasoning is now judging every claim (true, logical, useful); spend so far about $3.5 of $15.

Round 2 is in ($1.13): the fresh Opus backed 48 claims, disputed 3, and added opencode as a second thing to test. Verdicts and a 7-step plan are written, the first step being a small proxy test run; the plan is now with the Servex mastermind for review, spend about $6 of $15.

Landed: the research page at /framework/research/harness/ now shows the seven sub-areas as a grid with claim counts and verdicts, and the architect-reviewed plan is at ai/2026-09-28/harness-research/plan.md. First build is a proxy spike (the Claude Agent SDK through OpenRouter with a non-Claude model, opencode beside it); total spend about $11 of $15.
